start.title: [TODO:fr] Walking Away
start.text:
[TODO:fr] You and your friend leave the city.
Hope has died on a Roman cross.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Despair is not the last word.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Abandoned
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Sorrow speaks loudly, but listen.
Walk on. The road is not done.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] No one foresaw this morning.
Walk simply. Carry the grief.

stranger_joins.title: [TODO:fr] A Quiet Traveler
stranger_joins.text:
[TODO:fr] A stranger falls in step beside you.
"What are you discussing?" he asks.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Welcome Him
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A road shared is grief halved.
Speak. The stranger listens.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Mockery
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He has asked in kindness.
Answer him in kind.

share_grief.title: [TODO:fr] Concerning Jesus
share_grief.text:
[TODO:fr] "He was a prophet, mighty in word.
They crucified Him. We had hoped..."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Blame the women for the rumor
[TODO:fr] Cut the story short in shame
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Tell it whole. He is listening.

blame_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Blame
blame_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The women carried only what they saw.
Tell the story whole.

short_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Tell It All
short_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Hide nothing from this stranger.
He is more present than you know.

scripture.title: [TODO:fr] Foolish and Slow
scripture.text:
[TODO:fr] "Did the Christ not have to suffer
and so enter into His glory?"

offense_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Offense
offense_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] His sharpness is the surgeon's blade.
Receive it. It is healing you.

interrupt_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Be Still
interrupt_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] You do not yet see what he sees.
Let him finish. Then you will know.

burning_hearts.title: [TODO:fr] Hearts Aflame
burning_hearts.text:
[TODO:fr] Something kindles inside your chest.
You cannot name it, but it burns.

distrust_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Trust the Fire
distrust_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Your heart knows before your mind.
Let it lead you forward.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Heaven does not yield to demand.
Receive softly. Be carried.

invite_stay.title: [TODO:fr] Emmaus Village
invite_stay.text:
[TODO:fr] The village nears. He acts as if to go on.
The sun sinks low.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] He turns and follows you in.

letgo_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Lose Him
letgo_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Some moments must be held.
Call him back. Beg him to stay.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not for Price
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] A guest is welcomed, not sold to.
Open your door freely.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You set the table for three.

breaking_bread.title: [TODO:fr] He Took the Bread
breaking_bread.text:
[TODO:fr] He takes the bread. Blesses it.
Breaks it. Hands it to you.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look at His hands. See Him.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] This is no time for pride.

look_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Lift Your Eyes
look_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Do not miss this for hunger.
The Guest is the Lord.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look at His hands. See Him.

host_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Not Pride
host_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Your bread became His blessing.
Look. Receive. Be still.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Look at His hands. See Him.

recognition.title: [TODO:fr] He Vanishes
recognition.text:
[TODO:fr] It is the Lord! Your eyes are opened.
And then He is gone.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Sit stunned and stay the night
[TODO:fr] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Wait
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The night is no obstacle now.
Go. The eleven must hear.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem

whisper_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Tell Them All
whisper_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] This is not a secret to keep.
Let the city hear, "He lives!"

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Rise at once. Run to Jerusalem
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You set out into the dusk.

ending.title: [TODO:fr] He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
[TODO:fr] You burst in: "The Lord is risen!
He broke bread with us tonight."
